Subject (in full) Mongolian Princess, alleged espionage agent.
Princess N. de Torhout
Made to D.S. Jones
Date APR 19, 1934

On April 18, 1934 D.S. Gelin, attached to the Political Section of the French Concession Police, visited this office and requested permission to make enquiries in the International Settlement regarding the activities and movements of a Mongolian princess known as Nirgiana de Torhout.

D.I. Ross instructed me to accompany D.S. Gelin wherever he wished to go. Accordingly I went with the latter to the Palace Hotel, where the Princess was reported to be staying, and to the offices of the China Press and the North China Daily News, where we examined the newspaper files, without, however, finding anything relating to the Princess.

At the Palace Hotel it was learned that a person known to the management as Princess Nadine de Torhout had occupied Room 50 from April 11th, the date of her arrival by the s.s. 'Chenonceaux' from Marseilles, until the following day, when she took the afternoon train to Peiping. She stayed at the same hotel from November 18-21, 1932 and from March 12 - 19, 1933. On the latter occasion her brother stayed with her for two days.

She is understood to pass as a journalist; her age is about 25 years. It is reported that she speaks both French and English fluently and is understood to be well known to the various legation officials in Peiping.

According to D.S. Gelin this woman is a spy in the pay of the Japanese and frequents French naval officers. In reply to a question he informed me that this information came from Mr Sarly, who instructed him to make the necessary enquiries.

Officer i/c Special Branch
D.S. Jones

事由（全称） 蒙古公主，涉嫌间谍。
N. de Torhout 公主
致 D.S. Jones
日期 1934年4月19日

1934年4月18日，附属于法租界警务处政治部的侦探警佐 Gelin 访问本办公室，请求获准在公共租界内就一名被称为 Nirgiana de Torhout 的蒙古公主的活动和行踪进行调查。

巡官 Ross 指示我陪同侦探警佐 Gelin 前往其希望去的任何地方。据此，我随同后者前往华懋饭店（Palace Hotel），据报该公主下榻于此；随后又前往《字林西报》（China Press）和《北华捷报》（North China Daily News）的办事处，我们查阅了报纸档案，但未发现任何与该公主有关的内容。

在华懋饭店获悉，一位被管理层称为 Nadine de Torhout 公主的人士，自4月11日乘“舍农索”号（s.s. 'Chenonceaux'）轮船从马赛抵达之日起，至次日乘坐下午列车前往北平为止，一直占用50号房间。她曾于1932年11月18日至21日以及1933年3月12日至19日期间入住同一家酒店。在后一次入住期间，她的兄弟曾与她同住两天。

据悉，她以记者身份活动；年龄约25岁。据报道，她能流利地使用法语和英语，并据信为北平各公使馆官员所熟知。

据侦探警佐 Gelin 称，此女是一名受日本人雇佣的间谍，并与法国海军军官过从甚密。针对我的提问，他告知我这一情报来自 Sarly 先生，是 Sarly 先生指示他进行必要调查的。

特别部门主管警官
侦探警佐 Jones

档案
